# Pinned fixtures (inputs — never regenerated by a probe)

Every other file in this directory is a probe output, rewritten by
`run-suite.mjs`. These three are inputs: real CLI 2.1.195 sessions frozen
on 2026-07-13 so their uuids and model text can be pinned across probes.
Regenerating them would mint new uuids and new model output and would
mix drift in fixture *creation* into the behaviours under test (the
p4.q7 keep-reach drift is only observable because the fixture is fixed).

| file | origin | content |
|---|---|---|
| `p1-fixture-pre.jsonl` | `p0b-native-compact.mjs`, session `c4a1bb69-58cb-4e57-b5f9-7f7e27a9fe36` (its `p0b-native-compact-pre.jsonl` of that run) | U1 Read-tool turn (`fact.txt`, magic word `XYLOPHONE-77431`), U2 "What is 2+2?" → "4", U3 "Name any primary color" → "Red"; every turn nonce-tagged `NONCE-U1..3` |
| `p1-fixture-replay.jsonl` | same session after its native `/compact` (that run's `p0b-native-compact-post-compact.jsonl`) | the pre fixture + native `[compact_boundary, summary]` — the writer shape `p1-injection.mjs` case a replays verbatim |
| `p0c-restore-post-branch.jsonl` | Phase 0c tmux-driven interactive CLI (WORK-LOG "Phase 0c"), session `d3d313fa-9bc8-4dca-8549-5b20aa96dc4f`; plain Esc-Esc "Restore conversation" at U2, then a replacement prompt | in-file branch: trunk = U1 turn ending in `turn_duration`; branch 1 = U2 "4" → U3 "Red" (abandoned); branch 2 = U2B "6" (natural leaf) |

Pinned identifiers (8-char uuid prefixes; `round2.mjs` exports them for
the round-2 probes, the round-1 probes inline them):

- p1 fixture: `d6c57604` U2 user, `9f8ab726` U2 thinking, `d16f84b0` "4",
  `1a44a1ac` U3 user, `a6941d02` U3 thinking, `254029a1` "Red" (leaf);
  session id `c4a1bb69…` is reused as the resume id, with cwd
  `/tmp/clauctl-cbi-derisk/p0b-native-compact-cwd` so the project key matches.
- p0c fixture: `41a8c835` U1-turn assistant ("magic word"), `91d9474f`
  abandoned-branch leaf.

Consumers: p1, p1e, p2–p6, p8–p20 and `check-reports.mjs`.
